title: Mutation Envelope
description: Provenance, preconditions, idempotency, and independent domain and admission timestamps for a canonical mutation. Policy-dependent callers must supply non-empty observed_policy_versions.

origin_device_id.description: Stable registered identifier from operator-controlled local registration material; not a canonical UbU object id.

observed_versions.description: Version references use canonical decimal grammar with no leading zeros; numeric range bounding is the consuming type's responsibility.

observed_policy_versions.description: Policy reference to version reference; required and non-empty at policy-dependent call sites.

execution_context.description: Optional non-authoritative execution and backend provenance; cannot replace device, actor, or authority.
